source_of_truth: docs/aegis/plans/2026-09-13-setos-release-execution.md sections 5.1-5.3 (owner-accepted decisions), read back into an executable artifact
note: Every number here is an acceptance threshold, not a measurement. No result, no achieved rate and no admitted corpus is recorded in this file: the candidate manifest carries measurements, and the gate tool recomputes every statistic from raw counts. Changing a threshold is a versioned change to this file and must carry an explicit impact list (freeze_receipt.py exit 2), which is what keeps a lowered threshold from reading like a passed gate.

good_frame_budget.replaces: the old preservation-only gate; it does not weaken the remaining gates
good_frame_budget.decision_rule: point <= budget AND the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound <= budget; otherwise insufficient_evidence
good_frame_budget.all_silence_forbidden: keep_rate == 1.0 or abstain_rate == 1.0 fails the gate: all-KEEP or all-ABSTAIN cannot pass
good_frame_budget.independence_unit: source-shoot or session cluster, not near-identical adjacent frames
good_frame_budget.worked_example: even 0/81 independent clean good frames leaves a one-sided upper bound near 3.6%, so a small lucky set does not prove 2%

technical_failure.definition: frozen definition, not re-specified per run

published_ratios: wrong_confirmations / improved_issued (wrong confirmations over all issued improved)
wrong_improved / non_improved_episodes (wrong improved over all truly non-improved episodes)
false_improved.denominator_rule: both sides are published; the denominator is fixed before fit and may not be swapped to preserve 2%
false_improved.zero_issued_rule: with zero issued improved episodes precision is undefined, so the gate fails and coverage is not automatically passed

definition_source.app_claim: the app verifier's `improved` verdict, extracted from shafinMultitool/Multitool2Module/Models/CameraAnalysis/ActionVerifier.swift:424-455
definition_source.evaluator_extraction: NOT AVAILABLE: no evaluator in the repository computes false_improved (checked docs/cameraanalysis/eval and tools); the definition above is authored from the verifier and the episode vocabulary instead, and the first evaluator that implements it must be frozen as a versioned artifact before the locked test

false_improved.unverified_rule: an episode where the app claimed improvement but no independent truth is established blocks the derivation: an unverified improvement must never shrink a denominator

confusion_matrix.rule: the counts must add up to evaluated_total; incomparable is never dropped from the matrix

neural_gain.subset_rule: measured on a pre-chosen pass/expected-action or protected semantic subset, not on a post-hoc slice

gold.second_annotator: must not be invented; the gate takes an explicit declaration instead

calibration.silent_policy: the advising threshold is derived from calibration only (tools/release/plan_abstention_threshold.py), never from the locked test

split_grouping.group_key: origin family / shoot / derivative file, not random jpg
split_grouping.device_family: an analysis slice and a deliberate OOD protocol, with the existing split-rule conflict resolved explicitly
split_grouping.rule: grouping is decided before the lock and recorded in the split manifest

pending_pilot_parameters.status: not frozen; must be filled from the qualification pilot (P02/D03) before the locked test
pending_pilot_parameters.rule: until these are filled, a candidate may not claim the corresponding gates

runbook_requirements_not_enforced_by_the: per-class validation quota of 200 (the tool floors per class but has no separate validation bucket key)
20 style exceptions per action where applicable
per-source-shoot independence for FP_CORRECT beyond the explicit cluster_count field

trained_head_mask.rule: A head in contract_heads may ship untrained only if the manifest's untrained_head_mask lists it. An untrained contract head without a declared mask fails the gate, so three trained heads can never read as 'the rest are trained too'.
